**STEP 1 - Scene:** A airline-style meal tray with three servings: a stir-fry of meat and vegetables, a bowl of mixed cooked vegetables, and a bowl of fresh fruit, plus a glass of water. I treat the whole tray as this meal.

**STEP 2 - Vessels:** Stir-fry plate ~20 cm (area ~314 cm²). Vegetable bowl ~15 cm (area ~177 cm²). Fruit bowl ~17 cm (area ~227 cm²). The water glass has no food.

**STEP 3 - Items:** (a) stir-fried chicken/meat with peppers in brown sauce; (b) mixed vegetables (carrot, broccoli, corn); (c) fruit mix (watermelon, orange, grapes, strawberry, blueberry).

**STEP 4 - Area:**
- Stir-fry: ~60% of the plate (~188 cm²)
- Vegetables: ~80% of the bowl (~142 cm²)
- Fruit: ~85% of the bowl (~193 cm²)

**STEP 5 - Volume:**
- Stir-fry: 188 cm² × 1.2 cm ≈ 226 ml
- Vegetables: 142 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 213 ml
- Fruit: 193 cm² × 1.2 cm ≈ 232 ml

**STEP 6 - Grams:**
- Stir-fry: 226 ml × 0.8 ≈ 180 g
- Vegetables: 213 ml × 0.6 ≈ 128 g
- Fruit: 232 ml × 0.6 ≈ 139 g

**STEP 7 - Energy:**
- Stir-fry: 180 g × 150 kcal/100 g ≈ 270 kcal
- Vegetables: 128 g × 40 kcal/100 g ≈ 51 kcal
- Fruit: 139 g × 50 kcal/100 g ≈ 70 kcal

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** About 450 g and about 390 kcal is plausible for three modest airline-style servings covering most of their vessels. Water adds no energy.

Total: ~447 g, ~391 kcal.
